text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, wonderful!
If our research continues to go this well, it won't be long now!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, no, let's calm down.
Next comes the verification.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ideally, I would prefer to have test subjects other than you, my dear Trainer, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's see if there are any Umamusume
looking for a thrill.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Just any Umamusume won't do.
It has to be someone with a body suited for experimentation..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Choosing looks like quite a chore,
but this, too, is for the sake of research.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it,
it's almost time for training."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Oh well. Finding a test subject first will surely
make my dear Trainer much happier!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Wait and behold, Trainer-kun!
Behold our brand-new collaborator!

—And so, Agnes Tachyon got so absorbed
in searching for guinea pigs
that she never showed up for training...
